text.en:
Landing 4 Weapon Hits within 3 seconds of each other grants 'Heretical Behavior' for 8 (#e ?) seconds. Each hit only counts once every 0.4 seconds. Glaive Melees require 8 hits. Area-Denial Grenade Launchers require ? hits.

Heretical Behavior grants the following benefits while active:
• 8% Increased Damage
• 50? Handling
• 50? Reload Speed
• 20% Faster Reload Animation Speed

Buff can be refreshed.
